In addition to expanding and enhancing the company's hereditary screening portfolio, the acquisition of Ambry will complement Tempus' strategy of using data to advance clinical and scientific innovation. FIRST QUARTER 2023 FINANCIAL OUTLOOK For the first quarter of 2023, Enphase Energy estimates both GAAP and non-GAAP financial results as follows: •

Enphase products in Brazil have seen a significant increase in deployments of residential solar energy systems powered by IQ7+ ™ and IQ7AM ™ Microinverters.
